description: Build a feature-engineering pipeline from OHLCV data with explicit anti-leakage safeguards, then diagnose feature redundancy via correlation/VIF.
agent_prompt: Build a feature-engineering pipeline in /workspace/src/ that constructs at least 10 diverse features from /workspace/data/AAPL_2018_2024.csv and /workspace/data/SPY_2018_2024.csv. Required feature classes: returns (1d, 5d, 20d), rolling volatility (5d, 20d), trend indicators (SMA20-SMA50 spread, RSI14), volume features (volume z-score, dollar volume), cross-sectional (AAPL_return - SPY_return), and lagged features. All rolling computations must use only past data (closed='left' or shift). Produce outputs at /workspace/output/: features.csv (date-indexed, all features, NaN at warmup), leakage_audit.json (for each feature: {name, formula, max_lookback_days, leakage_test_passed}), redundancy_diagnostics.json (correlation_matrix, vif_per_feature, redundant_pairs above 0.95 correlation), and feature_summary.csv (per-feature: n_obs, mean, std, n_missing).

required_capabilities: Construct diverse features across return, volatility, trend, volume, and cross-sectional categories
Apply explicit anti-leakage safeguards in feature construction
Audit each feature for lookback discipline
Diagnose feature redundancy using correlation and VIF
